lines.text: That night she comes through clearer than she ever has, close enough to count her lashes. She is not in the cell. She stands in a high hall, and behind her hangs a banner. Black, worked with gold.
The same banner that rode up the west road.
She sees him seeing it. She doesn't flinch. She holds his eyes, lifts her chin toward the banner, and mouths something. No sound crosses. Then black.
The banner behind her was his. Whatever the emperor has, whatever makes armies that aren't men. It sits in a high hall, and it looks like her.
